items.zh: 不出所料，这种做法效果不佳。
一张脸远不止眼睛所看到的那么简单。
items.en: There is more to a face than meets the eye.

items.zh: 没有必要区分出如此细微的差别。
items.en: There's no need to make such fine distinctions.

items.zh: 什么是好问题，显然取决于语境。
items.en: What makes a good question obviously depends on the context.

items.zh: 多亏了社交媒体，人们遇到的面孔比以往任何时候都多。
items.en: Thanks to social media, people encounter more faces than ever before.

items.zh: 因为尽管出身微寒，成功于她唾手可得。
items.en: Success appeared to come almost effortlessly to her, even though her origins were humble.

items.zh: 这些学生表现出对社区发展项目的极大热情。
items.en: Students have shown great enthusiasm for these projects focusing on community development.
